summary: Regression + redesign polish testing for Caro iteration 2. Backend: re-ran existing pytest suite — 28/28 pass, no regression. Frontend: verified the client-reported bugs are fixed and new features work — (1) filter dropdowns (filter-borough/type/fuel) render with SOLID white background (rgb(255,255,255)) — transparency bug fixed; (2) min-max budget slider filter-budget renders; (3) all four collection tiles (collection-electric/executive/value/wav) render — electric filter correctly narrows to 2 cards; (4) spotlight-featured card present; (5) sort-select present; (6) search-btn works; (7) header account-menu-btn opens a solid white dropdown with all 7 requested items (Sign up as a driver, Log in as a customer, Log in/register as operator, Why choose Caro, Cost calculator, Get help, Legal & privacy); (8) VehicleDetail /vehicle/ve-001 renders OpenStreetMap iframe (location-map with src=openstreetmap.org), photo mosaic (8 imgs), detail-save toggles saved count to 1, apply-to-rent-btn navigates; (9) 4-step apply flow submits and shows apply-success; (10) new pages /why-caro /help /legal /calculator /saved /driver-guide /operator-guide all render without runtime errors; (11) Calculator calc-net updates when calc-breakdown toggle switched (£412→£420); (12) Help has help-search + 8 FAQs; (13) Operator dashboard tabs all render, recharts BarChart present (1 wrapper, 12 bar rects) on Overview; (14) Admin login (admin@caro.co.uk/CaroAdmin2026!) succeeds — 6 stat cards, 5 tabs, export-csv-btn all present.

issues: Order summary sidebar renders visually but lacks a data-testid attribute (spec mentions order-summary). Not blocking but reduces testability.

action_items: (Optional) Add data-testid="order-summary" to the sticky summary card in /app/frontend/src/pages/Apply.jsx around line 142 for improved test coverage.

(Optional, carried forward from iteration_1) CORS allow_origins=* with allow_credentials=True remains invalid per spec; no rate-limit on /api/auth/login; startup/shutdown events still using deprecated FastAPI decorators. None of these block current MVP behaviour.

Header.jsx account menu labels use 'Sign up as a driver' / 'Log in as a customer' — differs slightly from PRD wording ('Sign up as driver') but semantically identical. Not a bug.
Apply.jsx order summary sidebar is present but not testid-tagged; consider adding to keep parity with the rest of the codebase's data-testid convention.
OperatorDashboard renders recharts BarChart correctly; other tabs render but rely on static demo data (documented as mocked).

Console shows expected 401 on /api/auth/me for anonymous visitors and a few 404s for missing static resources — non-functional.
